pages.text: Allah revealed to His Prophet Musa (peace be upon him) that he should travel by night with those who believed with him, because Pharaoh and his soldiers would follow them.

So Musa and those with him travelled by night. When the companions of Musa saw Pharaoh's host, Musa said to them: ﴿كَلَّآۖ إِنَّ مَعِيَ رَبِّي سَيَهۡدِينِ﴾ — interpretation of the meaning: 'Never! My Lord is with me; He will guide me.'
Then Allah revealed to Musa that he should strike the sea with his staff; he struck it, and it split. Each part of the sea was like a great mountain.
The sea stayed split until Musa and those with him had crossed to the shore. So Allah saved Musa and all those with him.
